annotation.title_clean: PL 2338/2023 - Dispõe sobre o desenvolvimento, o fomento e o uso ético e responsável da inteligência artificial com base na centralidade da pessoa humana (Portal da Câmara dos Deputados)
annotation.title_en: Bill 2338/2023 - On the ethical and responsible development, promotion and use of artificial intelligence centred on the human person (Chamber of Deputies Portal)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Brazil); bill authored by Senado Federal - Rodrigo Pacheco
annotation.summary_en: Chamber of Deputies tracking page for Brazil's Senate-approved AI bill PL 2338/2023, awaiting rapporteur's opinion in a special committee. It lists about 37 attached bills on AI authorship, content labelling, education, health, and algorithmic governance. It contains no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: PL 2338/2023 sets rules for ethical, responsible AI development and use centred on the human person
Bill is in the Chamber's special committee, awaiting rapporteur's opinion, under priority procedure
About 37 related bills attached, covering copyright, synthetic content labelling, AI education and health use
Bill amends Law 14.533/2023 (digital education policy) and Law 11.540/2007 (FNDCT)
Indexing mentions self-regulation, penalties, competent authority and worker protection
